title: Register for the Nov 16 Virtual Office Hour on Visualization
content: Training News 2026 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Register for the Nov 16 Virtual Office Hour on Visualization 10/22 Register for the November 16 Virtual Office Hour on Visualization at RCSB.org in 2D and 3D ' class='img-responsive' style=''> Register for the November 16 Virtual Office Hour on Visualization at RCSB.org in 2D and 3D RCSB.org offers a variety of tools for exploring PDB structures and related chemical components in 3D and 2D. Mol* lets users display, represent, and color entire or partial structures to examine, explore, measure, and compare them. It also supports analyzing interactions throughout the structure or near a single residue or ligand, exploring sequence and structural motifs, and capturing images. The Sequence Annotations Viewer ( help guide | example ) maps information from multiple resources and databases onto PDB sequences and structures. Users can select a sequence annotation to focus on the corresponding location on the 3D Mol* view of the structure. Join Dr. Rachel Kramer Green for a brief overview of how to use tools like Mol*, followed by a Q&A about molecular visualization at RCSB PDB on: Monday November 16, 2026 1:00 -2:00pm Eastern | 10:00am - 11am Pacific. Please register for this free event. An institutional email address for registration is preferred. You will receive confirmation and a Zoom link by email before the event.
